author: ReviewMaxxer
quote: Too Much realism, grand theft auto game should be more arcade style, which always suited it, The story is a Mess, and Didn’t like any jokes in a parody game, Gta was meant to be a parody of America, but they have toned it down and jokes are unoriginal and uninteresting, the main characters are okay but story takes way too long to pick up any pace, Didn’t enjoy the First Half of the game much at all.
